description: This file provides utility functions for string formatting within a web application. It includes functions to convert strings to camelCase and Title Case, handling various delimiter characters and special cases such as apostrophes and accented characters.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, normalizing spaces and delimiters like hyphens and underscores.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case, capitalizing first letters of words and after apostrophes, handling accents and special characters.
